model_interpretation.claim: The serial coarse-root loop may leave cores idle when recursive shading workloads differ by tile. This candidate tests dynamic one-tile work assignment across root tiles, with run()'s thread count as the cap; the serial path is retained for one thread. It does not parallelize depth-bound rows, so its effect can be evaluated independently of that approach.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Pass run()'s thread count through to DispatchDynamicC and clamp the requested count to at least one.","Dynamically distribute independent coarse-root tiles in chunks of one when OpenMP is available and more than one thread is requested; preserve serial execution otherwise.","Leave depth-bound generation, higher tree levels, culling, and shading algorithms unchanged."]}

model_interpretation.claim: Each shaded pixel repeats indirect gathers through the same tile light-index list into separate light arrays, and recomputes invariant attenuation-end squared and attenuation range terms. A per-tile packed cache should amortize those loads and calculations while preserving the original per-pixel BRDF operations and light colors. This tests cache/preparation overhead versus reuse; the catalog has no earlier T3 candidates, and the baseline does not provide separate 1- and 4-core timings.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Pack each tile's referenced light positions, attenuation values, and color channels into a local cache once before shading its pixels.","Precompute each light's attenuation-end square and attenuation range once, reusing the same float operations and leaving per-pixel normalization, powf, and BRDF evaluation unchanged."]}

items.subject: Combiner le parallélisme des tuiles T1 et l’optimisation du shading T3
items.objective: Partir du candidat T1 le plus rapide et intégrer les changements mesurés de ShadeTileC de T3. Construire et mesurer la combinaison selon le protocole officiel, puis comparer les temps à 1 et 4 cœurs et vérifier les cas avec couleurs modifiées.
